info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Agents API
Factset Return Agents Items for a Fixed Income Security.

params.name: ids
params.description:
List of Fixed Income Security identifiers. Supported symbol types include CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, and FactSet Security Permanent Identifier (-S).

**ID LIMIT = 250** *per request*.

items.docs: Returns Agents data items for the Fixed Income security.

info.name: Factset Return Agents Items for a List of Fixed Income Securities.
